state.question: Assess Dahlia Compute's reported contract margin. I need the following measured result: Analysts' September gross-margin revision and the contracted wafer-cost change underlying it.
state.conclusion: Dahlia renewed a foundry contract for five years.
state.gap: Analysts' September gross-margin revision and the contracted wafer-cost change underlying it.

candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Theo Park's Dispatch's dispatch on Dahlia Compute, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Dahlia Compute's strategy in contract margin, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.abstract: An operating note about Dahlia Compute: The September estimate sheet gives next-year revenue of 6 billion crowns.

candidates.abstract: Dahlia wafer annex and analyst estimate sheet supports a dated assessment of analysts' September gross-margin revision and the contracted wafer-cost change underlying it.
